title: Filipino Cheese Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Mexican tacos, these Filipino cheese tacos feature a savory tadka-spiced beef short rib mixture, gooey cheese, and crunchy hard taco shells.
instructions: Season the beef short ribs with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef short ribs in batches, about 5 minutes per batch.
Transfer the browned beef to a plate and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the tadka spices, minced garlic, and browned beef back to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
While the short rib mixture is baking, warm the hard taco shells according to the package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the short rib mixture into the warmed taco shells.
Top with shredded cheddar cheese, chopped cilantro, and serve immediately.
